name: dsh-cdp-sidebar
description: Mirror the Chrome page on 127.0.0.1:9222 into the DSH right sidebar over CDP: chrome-devtools MCP drives Chrome, the sidebar shows a live screencast and sends mouse/keyboard back.

dsh.name: Chrome Sidebar (CDP mirror)
dsh.permissions: same-origin HTTP routes under /dsh-cdp; read-only probe of http://127.0.0.1:9222; client-side right sidebar tab
